decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 -0.3%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($489.29) sits just below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into a neutral tape, and letting existing positions ride on their stop-loss/profit-target rules.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with the S&P 500 underperforming the NASDAQ. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move — it reflects a market pausing to digest recent gains rather than reacting to fresh news. Volume and volatility both stayed muted, consistent with a wait-and-see mood among investors.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅整理，納指及標普500均輕微下跌，標普跌幅較納指明顯。市場並無單一主導消息帶動，走勢反映投資者在近期升勢後稍作消化，交投量及波幅均維持平靜，反映觀望氣氛濃厚。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" means keeping cash on the sidelines instead of investing it immediately, so it's ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. On a neutral, low-signal day like today, holding cash rather than forcing a trade preserves flexibility for when momentum clearly turns favorable.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者保留現金不急於投入市場，以便在真正出現強勁機會時才動用。像今日這種市況平淡、訊號不明確的日子，寧願持有現金觀望，也不勉強交易，可保留靈活性，等待明確的上升動力出現時再出擊。
